title: Ask for egress consent at the moment cloud is first needed
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. When cloud is the best route but not consented, ask right there with the specific destination and cost, remember the answer with a TTL. Tests zc_consent_jit_*.
